subject: auroter/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-NVFP4 TP2 qualification and local-agent deployment

sources.name: Auroter DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 NVFP4 model card and weights
sources.hardware_engine_relevance: Reports vLLM 0.26.0 TP4 on four RTX PRO 6000 cards. The local campaign translates only the parallel shape and bounded capacity to two equal cards.
sources.decision_impact: Selects Marlin W4A16 with DSpark disabled as the first correctness profile; W4A4 and DSpark remain later A/B lanes.

sources.name: vLLM 0.26.0 release
sources.hardware_engine_relevance: Pinned runtime named by the candidate model card; local SM120 behavior remains separately measured.
sources.decision_impact: Prevents substituting a newer nightly or older architecture path during the baseline.

sources.name: vLLM 0.26.0 Ubuntu 24.04 image
sources.hardware_engine_relevance: Exact amd64 runtime image used for the local launch.
sources.decision_impact: Pins CUDA, vLLM, Transformers, and compiled kernels as one reproducible identity.

sources.name: OpenClaw custom model provider contract
sources.hardware_engine_relevance: Client protocol only; no hardware-performance evidence.
sources.decision_impact: Requires an explicit OpenAI-compatible provider, declared reasoning capability, context/output limits, private-network allowance, and tested per-model parameters.

sources.name: Pi custom model provider contract
sources.hardware_engine_relevance: Client protocol only; no hardware-performance evidence.
sources.decision_impact: Uses ~/.pi/agent/models.json with openai-completions, explicit reasoning support, compatibility flags, and free-form served model identity.

sources.name: Pi DeepSeek V4 Flash reasoning mapping release
sources.hardware_engine_relevance: Client protocol only; no hardware-performance evidence.
sources.decision_impact: Pins the client floor whose xhigh level maps to DeepSeek V4 Flash max reasoning effort and whose OpenAI-compatible DeepSeek reasoning replay was corrected.
